session_note: WV 2026 regular session ran 2026-01-14 to 2026-03-14 (60-day session, per wvlegislature.gov). WV bills do NOT carry over between the two regular sessions of a legislature term: each regular session's unpassed bills die at sine die and must be reintroduced under a new bill number the next year. This is confirmed by the 2025 bills below (SB583, SB857, SB803, HB3137) which show no action past their 2025 session pages, while near-duplicate proposals (e.g. SB623 (2026), a reintroduction of the same data-center incentive concept as SB583/SB857 (2025)) appear under brand-new 2026 bill numbers rather than as continuations of the old ones.
